AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Land Preparation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Land Preparation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Land Preparation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Land Preparation.

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crop? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crop.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crop.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crop.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crop.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying General Crop Harvesting? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on General Crop Harvesting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to General Crop Harvesting.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about General Crop Harvesting.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of soil? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of soil.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of soil.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of soil.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of soil.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Weed control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Weed control.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Weed control.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Weed control.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Weed control.

8. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Breeds of Livestock? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Breeds of Livestock.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Breeds of Livestock.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Breeds of Livestock.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.

11. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

12. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain General Animal Health and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Beekeeping and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Rearing Project 3.0 Agricultural Technologies and Entrepreneurship 3.1 To and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Rearing Project and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

4. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crop.

5. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting.

6. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of soil.

7. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Weed control.

8. B — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

9. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock.

10. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.

11. D — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

12. B — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
